thread:
alex_support: FYI customer ACME hit us with a big latency regression after the v2.14 rollout a few mins ago. p95 jumped from ~420ms -> ~1.2s, p99 ~3s. raising to eng-runtime + oncall. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/12455 :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: runtime/v2.14.0 -> canary group at 10:38 UTC (sha: 9f4a2d)

maria_runtime: Thanks Alex. can you paste the sample request id and route? any headers or body shape that seems correlated?

alex_support: sample req id: req_abc123. route: POST /v1/generate. model: redwood-large. customer says spikes on both short and long prompts. Attaching quick logs and curl below.

alex_support: ```
[2026-03-16T10:40:59Z] req=req_abc123 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-large runtime=v2.14 canary=true queue_ms=140 token_ms=50 total_ms=3120
[2026-03-16T10:41:05Z] req=req_abc124 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-large runtime=v2.14 canary=true queue_ms=130 token_ms=52 total_ms=1200
```

alex_support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" 
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_abc123" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"short prompt"}'
```

maria_runtime: I see canary=true in logs. running quick query against telemetry for runtime=v2.13 vs v2.14 on p95/p99 for last 30m.

maria_runtime: preliminary: v2.13 p95 ~430ms / p99 ~900ms; v2.14 p95 ~1.05s / p99 ~2.9s. delta aligns with canary rollout window.

ryan_sre: Noted. Any config changes in v2.14? scheduler/kernel selector?

maria_runtime: v2.14 included: kernel-selector tweak (prefer fp16 fused kernels), new speculative-batching heuristic, and small auth cache TTL change (20s -> 10s).

jess_oncall: If kernel-selector is preferring a different codepath, that can blow up tail latency for some prompt shapes. Can we reproduce locally with the customer's workload?

maria_runtime: Requesting ACME cohort sample. Alex, can you ask for a small batch of representative requests (10-20) with headers + X-Request-ID? Prefer short and medium prompts.

alex_support: Sent to customer asking for trace ids and sample payloads. They gave 5 ids so far: req_abc123, req_def456, req_ghi789, req_jkl012, req_mno345.

maria_runtime: Thanks. spinning up a canary-repro job against v2.13 and v2.14 with those traces (cohort playback). will post results in ~15m.

[15m later]

maria_runtime: Replay results: v2.13 median 380ms p95 420ms p99 900ms. v2.14 median 430ms p95 1.15s p99 2.8s. repro successful on our internal canary nodes.

maria_runtime: flame graphs show a 40% increase in time spent in kernel selection + tensor conversion path for short prompts. speculative batching looks fine. suspect kernel-selector fallback causing synchronous path for some sequence lengths.

ryan_sre: Good repro. Mitigations: (1) rollback canary to v2.13 for affected cohort, (2) pin customer traffic to v2.13 cluster, (3) hotpatch to make kernel-selector opt-in via feature flag. Which is fastest?

jess_oncall: Rolling back the entire canary group is the quickest. Maria, can you prepare rollback playbook? I'll coordinate approval.

maria_runtime: Preparing rollback steps. quick commands:
```bash
# rollback canary allocation
redctl rollout set-runtime --group canary --version v2.13.9
# or pin tenant routing
redctl route update --tenant acme --runtime v2.13.9
```

alex_support: Customer asked for ETA. If we rollback canary to v2.13 can we confirm p95 returns to normal within 5-10m after traffic shift?

maria_runtime: Yes should see improvement within 1-2 sampling intervals (~5 min). I'll watch telemetry.

jess_oncall: @ryan_sre please approve rollback. I'll notify infra.

ryan_sre: Approving rollback. Do it. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: runtime canary -> v2.13.9 by jess_oncall at 10:58 UTC (action id: rb_20260316_1058)

maria_runtime: Monitoring...

[5m later]

maria_runtime: After rollback p95 for ACME cohort dropped to ~430ms, p99 ~920ms. Customer confirms latency improved.

alex_support: Customer says they're good for now, will reopen if they see anything else. They asked for a postmortem focused on root cause and mitigation.

maria_runtime: Plan: (A) bisect kernel-selector change to find the offending commit, (B) add unit/integration test in perf-cohort for short prompt tensorization, (C) add a runtime flag to control kernel preference, (D) longer-term: improve telemetry to surface kernel-path latencies per runtime. I'll file a GH issue and link.

alex_support: thanks all. tagging for follow-ups: @maria_runtime for bisect, @ryan_sre for rollback playbook cleanup, @jess_oncall for postop notes.

jess_oncall: I'll create a short incident note and link the customer ticket. Closing thread but keeping the follow-up TODOs in product board. :thumbsup:
